sentences.text: Shatrughan Kumre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3
December, 2025

Author: Aravind Kumar
Bench: Aravind Kumar
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2025
 @ Special Leave Petition (Criminal)
 No.13158/2025
 Shatrughan Kumre Appellant
 Versus
 State Of Madhya Pradesh And Anr. Respondents
 O R D E R
1. Heard.

2. Leave granted.
3.

The appellant who has been arraigned as an accused in FIR No.233/2025 for the offence punishable under Section 69 of The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 is before this Court after being denied the relief of anticipatory bail by the courts below and apprehending his arrest 1 Crl.No.___ of 2025 @ SLP (Crl.) No.13158/2025 4.
The case of the prosecution case is that on a false promise of marriage, the appellant had sexual intercourse with respondent No.2  prosecutrix due to which she had conceived.
Therefore, she has sought for action being taken against him as he did not fulfill his promise.

5. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties, at the outset, we notice that there was an interim protection granted in favour of the appellant by the order dated 08.09.2025 and there is no serious dispute by respondent No.1  State that appellant has been cooperating with the investigation and has appeared before the IO when called for investigation.

The records would also Shatrughan Kumre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100568948/
1 indicate that prosecutrix had also filed similar complaint against a doctor and had compromised the said matter.

sentences.text: The other FIR was registered as FIR No.336/2023 by Bhopal Urban, P.S. - Mahila Thana against one Deepak Nayak for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
For these 2 Crl.No.___ of 2025 @ SLP (Crl.) No.13158/2025 reasons, we are of the considered view that the interim protection granted earlier deserves to be absolute.

Accordingly,
it is made absolute and appellant is ordered to be released on bail by the jurisdictional Investigating Officer on such terms and conditions as it deems fit and subject to the condition that appellant shall cooperate with the investigation and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when called upon.
The appeal stands allowed.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
